topic.label: Protects ratepayers from data center costs
topic.description: Who pays for grid upgrades and electricity costs caused by data centers: the facility or household and business ratepayers.
topic.suggested_question: If a new data center requires grid upgrades, who do you think should pay for them?

statement.quote_text: The developer and the utility should cover the grid upgrades, not households.
statement.context_before: I would oppose a moratorium because it sends the wrong signal to employers.
statement.context_after: I also think the county board should hold public hearings before any approval.
